title: The window period for HIV and hepatitis C, by screening test
description: Bar chart of the window period, in days from the time a donation can first infect until each test detects the infection. HIV: antibody tests then in use, 45 days (an estimate by Petersen and colleagues, 1994); p24 antigen, 15; minipool nucleic acid test, 9; single-donation test, 5.6. Hepatitis C: antibody, 58; minipool test, 7.4; single-donation test, 4.9. All but the first are from the model of Busch and colleagues (2005), several as sums of its intervals.
heading: DAYS AN INFECTION GOES UNSEEN · HIV AND HEPATITIS C
